name: Backpack Seeker`s
detailed_description:
Backpack Seeker’s – A Tactical RPG Where Your Backpack Decides Your Fate

The king summoned you not for strength—but for your ability to turn every item into a weapon!

In Backpack Seeker’s, you’re an adventurer wielding a magical backpack where every slot is a strategic decision. This innovative hybrid blends classic RPG depth with inventory management akin to Backpack Battles—victory depends not on levels, but on how wisely you organize your gear!

Key Features

🎒 Your Backpack = Your Battlefield

  • Brutal Trade-offs: Block with a shield or strike with a greatsword? Every choice redefines your combat style.

  • Item Synergies: Discover 100+ hidden interactions—combine a magic crystal with an ancient scroll for devastating effects.

  • Legendary Artifacts: The "Vampire Amulet" isn’t just loot; fulfill conditions in battle to gain loyal pet companions!

⚔️ Next-Gen RPG Systems

  • Consequential Choices: Dialogue options and combat tactics dynamically alter the story’s ending.

  • Exploration Rewarded: Revisit dungeons with new items to unlock secret chambers and rare loot.

  • Living World: NPCs remember your actions—hero or villain, the world adapts.

For Whom?

✔ Fans of Backpack Battles craving a full-fledged RPG with deeper inventory mechanics
✔ Lovers of narrative-driven RPGs (Divinity-style) with open-ended progression
✔ Experimenters who relish discovering emergent gameplay

🚀 Game Development Roadmap

🔧 August 2024 – Preparatory Phase
Laying the foundation for an exciting adventure:
✔ Establishing the game’s technical base
✔ Prototyping core systems
✔ Unique combat system with backpack management
✔ Automated battles
✔ Basic inventory mechanics
✔ Character class design and unique traits

🎮 June 2025 – Demo Version
A first taste of epic battles and exploration!
⚔️ Gameplay:
✔ Deep combat system + inventory management
✔ 2 unique classes (Ice and Earth elements)
✔ 100+ items with unexpected effects
✔ Survival mechanics: hunger and cave exploration

📜 Content:
✔ 2 shops with exclusive items
✔ Engaging opening story
✔ A series of quests to immerse players in the world

✨ December 2025 – Full Release
The world expands, possibilities multiply!
🌍 New Features:
✔ 3 large-scale zones (forests, ruins, dungeons)
✔ Additional classes (Fire and Air elements)
✔ Mounts and crafting mechanics

🏆 Improvements:
✔ Vastly more items and artifacts
✔ PvP arenas with rankings and rewards
✔ Branching storylines with multiple endings and hidden scenarios
✔ Global localization + Steam achievements

🌐 September 2026 – Major Update
The game goes multiplayer!
🔗 Online Features:
✔ Cross-platform servers
✔ Global chat, guilds, and PvE raids
✔ In-game trading marketplace for artifacts

🍳 New Depth & Experiments:
✔ Cooking system (150+ recipes with buffs)
✔ Tactical "backpack battles" with combo effects
✔ Teleporters and secret clan zones

💡 Why Follow This Project?
✔ Gradual evolution – Each phase adds layers of depth and variety.
✔ Flexible mechanics – From solo play to large-scale online battles.
✔ Post-launch support – DLC plans already in development, featuring new continents and professions!

Join the community to influence the game’s development through votes and playtests!

Tech Specs

Genres: RPG, Strategy, Fantasy
Platforms: Windows, macOS

short_description: Backpack Seeker’s — a tactical RPG where your backpack decides everything! Collect, combine, and use items in unique ways to win. A living world, a nonlinear story, and hundreds of hidden mechanics await! Ready for an adventure where every item is a step to victory? 🎒⚔️
supported_languages: English, Russian, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 1.5 GHz (Intel/AMD)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon HD 6000 / NVIDIA GeForce 7000 (или аналогичные)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (1.7 GHz) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris 5100 / Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
